case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1145 OF 2011; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1160 OF 2025

parties.petitioner: Tanaji Shamrao Kale, Ratu, Satu, Maruti

summary: Conviction under IPC s.302/148/149 upheld; corroborated eyewitness accounts of PW-1, PW-2, PW-5; alibi defense rejected based on duty records; omission in police statement not material; role of appellant Tanaji confirmed by PW-1 and PW-2; PW-5's non-mention explained by early departure from scene; no material contradictions in testimony; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence of life imprisonment upheld.
